enabled.description: Enable or disable the pflogsumm cron job.

log_file.description: Primary Postfix log file to analyze.

items.description: Path to an additional Postfix log file (e.g., /var/log/mail.log.1 for rotated logs).

extra_logs.description: List of extra log files to include (e.g., rotated logs).

mail_to.description: Email address that receives the log summary.

mail_from.description: Email sender address. Leave empty to use the default ('postfix').

mail_subject_prefix.description: Prefix for the email subject line (e.g., '[pflogsumm]').

days.description: Number of days of logs to summarize (0 = all available).

verbose.description: Include verbose details in the summary (e.g., per-host stats).

detailed.description: Include detailed sender/recipient lists (can be large for busy systems).

tz_offset.description: Time zone offset in minutes (e.g., +60). Leave empty to use system time zone.

pflogsumm_bin.description: Full path to the pflogsumm executable.

pflogsumm_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to pflogsumm.
